input_zh: Analysis 权威控制固定于持久 Worker Claimed 之后的 main 提交 39924feb58828fa25b31378ee9b6800885664250：Research Runtime Scheduler V3.0、Worker Control v1.3.0、Generated Analysis Prompt v2.0.0（声明 SHA-256 为 4f40dff2d12569f647bf265f344b60cb0f0cd0349f0b2d5cf1023f50947dfea2）以及同一控制谱系上的全部 7 个 requiredSources。对精确 Generated Prompt UTF-8 字节直接计算 SHA-256 后完全匹配。已核验同日 Analysis Wake Receipt 为 research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-15/analysis-125745.json。Ordered Runtime Reconciliation 仅在正式 13:00 边界之后于 13:05:15+08:00 打开 Analysis Execution Slot；原生 Worker Claim Workflow 于 13:06:05+08:00 持久记录 fresh Worker Claimed。Analysis 只消费已 Completed 的 2026-09-15 Reading Result 与恰好 2 份同日来源完整 Reading Note。
workResult: Applied Skill 04 to exactly two same-date source-complete Reading Notes and produced two bounded Research Objects. Q-20260915-01 concludes that durable Agent memory is a provenance-bearing temporal commitment rather than a property inferred from persistence: observed content, lifecycle classification, storage/update path and read authority should remain separate, with promotion and revocation materialized as explicit auditable transitions. The strongest primary evidence shows that lifecycle-conditioned routing and protected readout can reduce temporary overwrite when lifecycle labels are already known; it does not establish autonomous classification, promotion, revocation or truth authority. Q-20260915-02 concludes that Agent recovery should preserve separate evidence for failure detection, recovery routing, correction input, retry budget, acceptance and external-effect reconciliation. LAST-CQ supports a bounded finding that execution-grounded detection plus one bounded retry carries much of the recoverable value in a structured executable domain, while richer feedback adds little there and equal-budget parallel sampling can be worse; the evidence does not authorize blind retry of state-changing tools or equate execution with semantic correctness. Both objects are ReadyForProduction with production_input_authorized=true and publication_authorized=false. No article drafting, candidate staging, cover generation, Production or Publication was performed.
workResult_zh: Skill 04 严格消费 2 份同日来源完整 Reading Note，并生成 2 份有界 Research Object。Q-20260915-01 的结论是：Durable Agent Memory 是带 Provenance 的时间承诺，而不是由持久化自动推导出的属性；Observed Content、Lifecycle Classification、Storage/Update Path 与 Read Authority 应保持分离，Promotion 与 Revocation 应成为显式、可审计的状态转换。最强一手证据只证明：当 Lifecycle Label 已知时，Lifecycle-conditioned Routing 与 Protected Readout 可以降低 Temporary Overwrite；它并未证明自主分类、Promotion、Revocation 或 Truth Authority。Q-20260915-02 的结论是：Agent Recovery 应分别保留 Failure Detection、Recovery Routing、Correction Input、Retry Budget、Acceptance 与 External-effect Reconciliation 的证据。LAST-CQ 支持一个有界判断：在结构化可执行领域，Execution-grounded Detection 加一次 Bounded Retry 承担了大量可恢复价值，更复杂 Feedback 在该环境中的增益很小，同等预算的 Parallel Sampling 还可能更差；这些证据不授权对状态变更工具 Blind Retry，也不能把 Execution 等同于 Semantic Correctness。两份对象均为 ReadyForProduction、production_input_authorized=true、publication_authorized=false。未执行文章写作、Candidate Staging、题图生成、Production 或 Publication。
